entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Kestrel accepts arbitrary/unknown transfer-codings before a final chunked (TE: identity,chunked / anything,chunked) — surfaced to app, keep-alive; nginx/HAProxy reject-close [revisit of #43664 decision] #69577
  • [Backport request][security] PR #65765 (HTTP/2 trailer CL-mismatch → connection-level GOAWAY) is not in any supported release — verified live on 8.0.31, 9.0.20, 10.0.12 #69575
  • [Backport request] Enforce RFC 9113 connection-specific header rejection on .NET 10 LTS — transfer-encoding/keep-alive/proxy-connection/upgrade still accepted in HTTP/2 requests #69574
  • Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.SqlServer.DatabaseOperations Does not Support RetryLogicProvider #69573
  • Error On Building Blazor_WASM Project: mnMicrosoft.NET.Sdk.WebAssembly.Browser.targets #69571

Closed

  • Kestrel returns empty page without calling middleware for certain query parameters #69576
  • Output and Response Caching treat absent and empty query/header values as the same cache key #68943
  • Response Caching: include retained cache-key bytes in MemoryCacheEntryOptions.Size #69214
  • `CacheTagHelper`: `MemoryCacheEntryOptions.Size` omits `vary-by` key memory #66723
  • Partially deployment for Asp.net Core Blazor Web Apps #69546
  • gRPC AuthContext: SAN dNSName extraction relies on parsing X509Extension.Format() text instead of typed API #69169
  • Add minimal-diff and Native AOT test guidance for coding agents #69508
  • Some CI legs are still running for .md changes #69148
  • [Hot Reload with dotnet watch] Blazor WASM Standalone hot reload reports changes applied but UI is not updated in .NET 11 Preview 6 #67611
    11.0-rc2
  • Quarantine RoutingTest.NavigationLock_OverlappingNavigationsCancelExistingNavigations_PushState #68642
    .NET 12 Planning
  • Blazor Server: EventCallback on child pagination component does not invoke parent handler in specific page context #65892
  • HeadContent is not working when in SSR #66841
  • Error FilterStaticWebAssetEndpoints on build after updating to net10 (CSS?) #66599
  • Blazor with Radzen problem #66842
  • Blazor Server InputFile crashes process (0xffffffff) when debugging with VS 2026 Insiders + SDK 10.0.301 #67200
  • Form validation for Blazor (EditForm) to include validation error message for data annotations and custom validation at the same time #66966
  • aspnet:10.0 - FailFast crash in TypeDescriptor.GetProperties() / ConcurrentDictionary..ctor() after upgrading from 10.0.8 to 10.0.9 #67270
  • Blazor WASM with fingerprinting enabled will make blazor.webassembly.{..}.js point to dotnet.js in error #67766
  • Blazor WASM on IIS Express: Unable to correctly rewrite content-encoding of precompressed static file #67884
  • OpenAPI document generation retains collectible endpoint contract assemblies #68564
  • [Blazor Hybrid] A single lost render-batch ack permanently corrupts WebViewRenderer's unacknowledged batch queue #68674
  • Blazor WebAssembly runtime intermittently fails to start under concurrent page loads (.NET 10) #68697
  • Static SSR: stack overflow — StaticHtmlRenderer's HTML walk cycles through a disposed SectionOutletContentRenderer when a section registration races the walk #69035
